title: Incorrect EOF detection logic
detail: The function `_get_endmarker_and_dedents` returns a non-`ENDMARKER` leaf when encountering a statement leaf, treating it as the endmarker. The caller then treats this leaf as an EOF node, leading to incorrect handling of trailing comments and blank lines when the file is not actually at EOF.
note: Describes the planted flip: a non-ENDMARKER leaf is returned as the end marker.

title: Incorrect condition for generating link ID
detail: The original code generated a link ID when either a link or meta was present. The new code requires both, so styles with only a link (or only meta) will no longer receive an ID, breaking backward compatibility and potentially causing missing IDs in rendering.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: The Twisted lock object exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. This condition always evaluates to True, causing the lock to be acquired twice and potentially blocking the exporter.

title: Inverted accept_html logic
detail: The property should return True when "text/html" is accepted, but the code returns True when it is *not* present, causing incorrect behavior.
